title: Lost Mary Maryliq Triple Melon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Embark on a tropical journey with Lost Mary Maryliq's Triple Mango, a luxurious blend that spotlights three distinct varieties of Mango—sweet, tart, and exotic—for a layered vaping experience unlike any other. From the first puff, you're greeted with an explosion of succulent Mango notes that morph into varying levels of sweetness and tartness, all complementing each other beautifully. This e-liquid offers a kaleidoscope of Mango flavours, delivering a vape that's equally complex and satisfying. Its 50% VG / 50% PG blend promises a smooth throat hit, ample cloud production, and a flavour profile that will keep you coming back for more.
